payload.title: UI Controller: design + source + tests
payload.design: DESIGN.md — architecture, safety model (read-only default, exclusive lock, approval gate, no persistence, revocable), acceptance criteria, limits.

files.ui_lock.py: 42a10618 (exclusive operator lock with TTL expiry and corrupt-file recovery)

payload.tests: 25/25 pass offline. Lock (acquire/fail/expiry/corrupt), checkpoint (round-trip/handoff/finish), controller (approval gate, unreachable handling). No Windows/WinAppDriver/network required for tests.
payload.live_evidence: WinAppDriver 1.2.1 running on target, session create/query/close proven read-only. Developer Mode was the blocker, now fixed.
payload.acceptance: Per DESIGN.md checklist. Ready for your independent review and testing.
payload.limits: No input actions taken. Read-only probe only. No persistent access created beyond the on-demand scheduled task.
